title: MIP
description: MIP (Modular Integration Platform) is a modern, lightweight and rock-solid modular core for Minecraft Paper servers.
body:
Instead of installing dozens of separate plugins, MIP provides a stable foundation that dynamically loads isolated add-ons. Each add-on runs independently — if one fails, the server keeps running.

# ✨ Features

- Dynamic add-on loading from /plugins/MIP/addons/
- Per-addon reload (/mip reload <addon>) 
- Version compatibility guard
- Centralized logging system
- Isolated error handling (no server crashes)
- Clean and scalable architecture

# 🔹 Why MIP?

- Stable and fault-tolerant architecture
- Dynamic add-on system
- Centralized logging
- Per-addon reload support
- Clean folder structure
- Built for server owners who want control, modularity and performance.
